tickerText: [TENNIS] Fils beats Tiafoe 6-3, 1-6, 6-0 for first Masters 1000 title; Gauff tops Pegula 6-2, 6-4 for second Cincinnati crown • [SQUASH] PSA Budapest Open opens Aug 24 at Millenáris — $43K Copper draw with eight Top-50 seeds and three Hungarians • [BADMINTON] France's historic BWF Worlds double — Lanier & Gicquel/Delrue; An Se-young reclaims crown over Yamaguchi • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Nationals open 2026-27 PPA season Aug 31 in Cary — World Pickleball Rankings debut • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao runs Sep 8–13; Lebrun & Wang Manyu fresh off Malmö Grand Smash wins

newsItems.title: Fils & Gauff Crowned in Cincinnati
newsItems.excerpt: Arthur Fils edged Frances Tiafoe 6-3, 1-6, 6-0 for France's first Masters 1000 title in 12 years, while Coco Gauff beat Jessica Pegula 6-2, 6-4 in the first all-American women's final since 1970.

newsItems.title: France's Historic BWF Worlds Double
newsItems.excerpt: Alex Lanier and Thom Gicquel/Delphine Delrue delivered France's first men's singles and mixed doubles world titles, while An Se-young reclaimed the women's crown with a 21-17, 21-14 win over Akane Yamaguchi.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Open PPA Season
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026-27 Carvana PPA Tour kicks off Aug 31 in Cary with the Veolia Pickleball National Championships, debuting the unified World Pickleball Rankings system.

newsItems.title: WTT Macao & Malmö Champions
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Macao runs Sep 8–13 with 64 top singles players, while Felix Lebrun and Wang Manyu claimed Malmö Grand Smash crowns earlier this month.
